description: This file defines the UnwritableStreamException class, which extends RuntimeException and implements ExceptionInterface. It provides static factory methods for creating specific exception instances related to stream writing errors within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace.

classes.name: UnwritableStreamException
classes.description: An exception class indicating errors related to unwritable streams, providing static methods to generate specific exception instances.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating the stream is not writable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating no resource is available for writing.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an error occurred while writing to the stream.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating callback streams cannot be written to.

calls: new self('No resource available; cannot write')
